files_modified.behavior_after: Claude Code Verify SKILL SET (S5): meta-review layer, not re-analysis. Input: reports/<slug>-phase2-merged.json only (no raw source code by default). Tasks: (1) check merge stats + escalation conditions (conflict rate >50%, agent-b missing, schema errors); (2) spot-check top 3-5 highest-severity findings for reasoning coherence, reference plausibility, verdict support — source code read permitted only for suspicious findings (1 file, 10 total limit); (3) resolve conflicts by reading both agents' reasoning + source at reference location, evidence-based resolution (Tier 1/2 only, else REVIEW); (4) flag malformed findings (missing entry_point_id, empty reasoning, wrong verdict values). Output: verify session JSON with escalations, spot_checks, conflict_resolutions, malformed_findings, summary (overall_quality). File behavior: backup -phase2-merged.json → -phase2-pre-verify.json, overwrite -phase2.json with corrections. Rules: minimize tokens, one pass only, no re-analysis, R4 evidence-based conflict resolution, R5 escalation is not failure.
